strategy_roster.name: Strategy Sema Sdi Webhook
strategy_roster.notes: The documented FastEmaLength=58 and SlowEmaLength=70 are used directly; +DI > -DI has no DSL equivalent so positive 14-bar directional movement stands in, and the SmoothLength=3 and DiLength=1 smoothing steps are dropped. The documented StopLossPercent=4.8 and TakeProfitPercent=25 are applied as percentages, while TrailingPercent=1.9 has no fixed-field equivalent.

strategy_roster.name: Two-Pole Ideal MA
strategy_roster.notes: TEMA is rebuilt exactly from nested EMAs as 3*e1 - 3*e2 + e3 with the documented SlowPeriod=30, and the crossover with the documented FastPeriod=10 EMA gives entry and reverse exit. The short branch is dropped for long-only and the docs state no stops.

strategy_roster.name: Triangle
strategy_roster.entry_long: sma(close,10) > sma(close,30) and roc(close,14) > 0 and macd(close,12,26) > macd_signal(close,12,26,9)
strategy_roster.notes: The three documented timeframes (execution, trend and monthly MACD) are collapsed onto one series, weighted averages become simple ones, and the 14-period momentum above the neutral 100 becomes a positive 14-bar rate of change with MomentumThreshold dropped. FastMaPeriod/SlowMaPeriod=10/30 and the 12/26/9 MACD are explicit defaults, and StopLossSteps/TakeProfitSteps are tick distances, so stops are null.

strategy_roster.name: MACD + Stochastic Trend Filter
strategy_roster.entry_long: crossabove(macd(close,12,26), macd_signal(close,12,26,9)) and macd(close,12,26) < 0 and roc(ema(close,26),1) > 0 and rsi(close,2) > rsi(close,14)
strategy_roster.notes: The documented MACD 12/26/9 bullish crossover while the line is still below zero and the rising EMA(26) filter are kept literally; Stochastic is unavailable, so the %K-above-%D condition becomes fast RSI above slow RSI with the documented 15/3/3 lengths approximated by RSI(2) and RSI(14). MacdOpenLevel/MacdCloseLevel in price steps and the point-based stop, target and trailing stop are unsupported, so stops are null.

strategy_roster.name: Martingale Bone Crusher
strategy_roster.notes: Only the documented fast/slow SMA direction is a market signal, and both lengths are undocumented so 10/20 are explicit defaults; the Martingale1/Martingale2 sizing, money and percentage targets, breakeven trigger and money/step trailing are all dropped. StopLossSteps/TakeProfitSteps are instrument price steps rather than percentages, so both stop fields are null.

strategy_roster.name: Line Order Single Entry
strategy_roster.notes: The trigger is a user-supplied absolute Entry Price level rather than any derived market condition, so there is no signal to translate into price-relative DSL. Marked non-trading; the pip stop, target and optional trailing are distances from that manual level.

strategy_roster.name: Color Zerolag JJRSX
strategy_roster.notes: The custom JJRSX colour indicator is replaced by a fast RSI line against a smoothed slow RSI line, with 5 and 14/9 as explicit defaults because FastPeriod and SlowPeriod are not documented; the documented fast-below-slow cross opens the long and the opposite cross closes it. The short branch, the Buy/Sell permission flags and StopLoss/TakeProfit in price units are dropped, so stops are null.

strategy_roster.name: Term Structure Commodities
strategy_roster.notes: Carry is the spread between front and deferred futures for a cross-section of commodity contracts, ranked monthly with contract rolls, which needs two price series per instrument plus cross-sectional ranking; none of that exists in a single-ticker DSL. Marked non-trading instead of substituting a price-only proxy that would change the strategy.

strategy_roster.name: MTrainer
strategy_roster.notes: This is a manual practice utility (Category: Utility, designed for the visual tester) driven by absolute price levels - EntryPrice, TakeProfitPrice, StopLossPrice, PartialClosePrice - all defaulting to 0, so it produces no market-derived signal. Marked non-trading; partial closes and absolute price levels are not expressible as percentage stops.

strategy_roster.name: Time Trader
strategy_roster.notes: Entries happen exactly at TradeHour:TradeMinute:TradeSecond (default 00:00:00) regardless of price, with Indicators listed as None, so this is a schedule-only EA with no market-derived entry signal. Marked non-trading; the documented TakeProfit=0.2 and StopLoss=0.2 have no stated unit and are not used as percentages.
